decisions.reason: Floor-level shower drainage is the firm's core competence and strategic direction, so its deep related knowledge lets it keep refining this line rather than abandon it.
As the flagship designer shower drain, it builds directly on proven drainage technology and the firm's design focus, so management will keep developing it.

The sloped shower element complements the firm's integrated, low-profile floor-level systems and waterproofing know-how, though it lies further from metal fabrication and is less prominently featured.
The backflow-protected basement drain applies the firm's established drainage and sealing expertise to a related segment, so it can interpret market feedback and improve it.
